definition: Clinical Arabic phrase for erectile dysfunction; literally 'weakness of erection,' used in medical contexts and health journalism across the Arab world.
notes: Standard MSA medical phrase; widely encountered in pharmaceutical advertising (Viagra campaigns, etc.) and health media; انتصاب is the clinical noun for erection.

definition: Clinical phrase meaning 'deficiency in sexual performance,' used as a broad umbrella term for sexual dysfunction in medical and academic Arabic writing.
notes: Broader than ضعف الانتصاب; encompasses erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, anorgasmia, and other performance failures; no single-concept registry match, mapped to erectile_dysfunction as the closest available.

definition: Descriptive clinical phrase for dyspareunia; literally 'pain during intercourse,' used in patient education and lay health communication.
notes: Descriptive phrase rather than a coined technical term; parallel formal term is عسر الجماع; جماع carries mild taboo weight, lifting crude score slightly above zero; applies to both male and female presentations.

definition: Formal medical Arabic term for dyspareunia; literally 'difficulty of intercourse,' used in clinical gynecology, urology, and sexology literature.
notes: Classical Arabic construction using عسر (difficulty/hardship, the antonym of يسر); more technical and less colloquially accessible than الألم أثناء الجماع; covers both vaginismus-pattern and penetration-pain presentations; found primarily in medical textbooks and specialist clinical notes.
